question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
-- Top 3 revenue-generating films for each actor, plus average revenue per actor across those top 3 films
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
film_actor_count AS (
    SELECT 
        film_id,
        COUNT(actor_id) as num_actors
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        a.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        fr.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fr.total_revenue / fac.num_actors as actor_share
    FROM actor a
    JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
    JOIN film_actor_count fac ON fr.film_id = fac.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        film_id,
        title,
        actor_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY actor_share DESC) as rn
    FROM actor_film_revenue
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT 
    t.actor_id,
    t.first_name,
    t.last_name,
    t.film_id,
    t.title,
    ROUND(t.actor_share, 2) as actor_share,
    ROUND(AVG(t.actor_share) OVER (PARTITION BY t.actor_id), 2) as avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM top3 t
ORDER BY t.actor_id, t.rn
